title: Compare EC50 models
text: Use ec50_multimodel() need compare candidate dose-response models reporting EC50 estimates. function fits model within isolate stratum, stores fitted drc objects, returns data frame EC50 estimates plus model-selection statistics.

title: Compare EC50 models
code: library(ec50estimator) library(drc) library(ggplot2) data(multi_isolate)  example_data <- subset(   multi_isolate,   isolate %in% 1:5 & fungicida == "Fungicide A" )  head(example_data) ##   isolate   field   fungicida  dose     growth ## 1       1 Organic Fungicide A 0e+00 20.2082399 ## 2       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-05 20.1168279 ## 3       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-04 19.2479678 ## 4       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-03 15.8123455 ## 5       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-02  7.3206757 ## 6       1 Organic Fungicide A 1e-01  0.6985264

title: Compare EC50 models
text: Repeated observations dose shown points, connected lines. Lines reserved fitted model curves. exploratory plot uses positive doses x-axis log-scaled.
code: raw_plot_data <- subset(example_data, dose > 0)  ggplot(raw_plot_data, aes(dose, growth, color = factor(isolate))) +   geom_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +   facet_wrap(~field) +   scale_x_log10() +   labs(x = "Dose", y = "Growth", color = "Isolate") +   theme_light()

title: Compare EC50 models
text: fit_quality() summarizes successful model fits. fit_failures() returns failed group/model combinations data.

title: Compare EC50 models
text: model_selection() ranks models inside isolate field. default criterion IC, returned ec50_multimodel(). Smaller values better. best_model() keeps top-ranked model group. Model weights relative candidate set supplied user. useful ranking fitted models, prove model biologically correct.

title: Fit one EC50 model
text: estimate_EC50() takes drc model function fct. example fits three-parameter log-logistic model within isolate field. object behaves like data frame. first columns identify isolate strata. remaining columns contain EC50 estimate uncertainty columns returned drc::ED().

text: Use ec50_multimodel() want compare one drc model. model list fitted within isolate field stratum. returned object data-frame-like compatibility. also stores original formula, grouping columns, fitted models, fit diagnostics.

text: Use fit_quality() see whether isolate/model combination enough observations dose levels. Use fit_failures() get failed fits data, instead searching warning text.

title: Get started with EC50 workflows
text: model_selection() ranks candidate models within isolate stratum. Lower information-criterion values better. delta column measures difference best-supported model group, weight gives relative information-criterion weight. Use best_model() want one selected model per isolate stratum.

what: An Automated Way to Estimate EC50 for Stratified Datasets
title: An Automated Way to Estimate EC50 for Stratified Datasets
text: ec50estimator helps scientists estimate EC50 grouped dose-response datasets. wraps modelling engine drc workflow easier use experiments many isolates, fields, fungicides, years, strata. package built around one practical sequence: Check whether dose-response data fit-ready. Fit one model compare several candidate models. Inspect fit quality failed fits. Plot fitted curves ggplot2. Extract predictions, curve coordinates, manuscript-ready EC50 tables.

title: An Automated Way to Estimate EC50 for Stratified Datasets
text: Install stable release CRAN. Install development version GitHub.

title: An Automated Way to Estimate EC50 for Stratified Datasets
text: fit still data frame, existing workflows call head(fit) write estimates file continue work. also stores fitted drc models metadata needed helper functions: See pkgdown site recommended workflow: https://alvesks.github.io/ec50estimator/.
code: library(ec50estimator) library(drc)  data(multi_isolate)  example_data <- subset(   multi_isolate,   isolate %in% 1:5 & fungicida == "Fungicide A" )  check_ec50_data(   example_data,   response = "growth",   dose = "dose",   isolate = "isolate",   strata = "field" )  fit <- ec50_multimodel(   growth ~ dose,   data = example_data,   isolate_col = "isolate",   strata_col = "field",   fct = list(drc::LL.3(), drc::LL.4(), drc::W2.3()),   interval = "delta" )  best_model(fit) plot_EC50_curves(fit, models = "best") report_ec50(fit, models = "best") curve_data(fit) fitted_models(fit) ec50_metadata(fit) predict_ec50(fit, dose = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.1), models = "best") plot_residuals(fit, models = "best")

what: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
title: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
text: `estimate_EC50()` fits one dose-response model per isolate, optionally within strata year, site, treatment, fungicide. `ec50_multimodel()` repeats workflow several `drc` model functions returns model-selection statistics estimates.

title: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
code: estimate_EC50(   formula,   data,   EC_lvl = 50,   isolate_col,   strata_col = NULL,   fct,   interval = c("none", "delta", "fls", "tfls"),   type = c("relative", "absolute"),   quiet = FALSE )  ec50_multimodel(   formula,   data,   EC_lvl = 50,   isolate_col,   strata_col = NULL,   fct,   interval = c("none", "delta", "fls", "tfls"),   type = c("relative", "absolute"),   quiet = FALSE )

title: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
text: formula two-sided formula identifying one numeric response one numeric dose column, example `growth ~ dose`. data data frame containing numeric response, numeric dose, isolate, optional stratification columns. EC_lvl Numeric effective-dose level(s) passed [drc::ED()]. default estimates EC50. isolate_col Character scalar naming column identifies isolate. strata_col Optional character vector naming columns used split data fitting models. fct `drc` model function object `drc::LL.3()` `estimate_EC50()`. `ec50_multimodel()`, provide list `list(drc::LL.3(), drc::LL.4())`. interval Character scalar passed [drc::ED()]. One `"none"`, `"delta"`, `"fls"`, `"tfls"`. type Character scalar passed [drc::ED()]. One `"relative"` `"absolute"`. quiet Logical. `FALSE`, failed isolate/model fits reported warning.

title: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
text: data frame one row per successful estimate. first columns   identify isolate (`ID`) strata, followed columns returned   [drc::ED()]. `ec50_multimodel()` also appends model-selection statistics   [drc::mselect()] `model` column. result keeps data-frame   behavior, also stores original data, formula, grouping columns, model   functions, fitted `drc` models can passed directly   [plot_EC50_curves()].

title: Estimate effective doses for grouped dose-response data — estimate_EC50
code: data(multi_isolate) sample_data <- subset(   multi_isolate,   isolate == 1 & fungicida == "Fungicide A" )  estimate_EC50(   growth ~ dose,   data = sample_data,   isolate_col = "isolate",   strata_col = c("field", "fungicida"),   fct = drc::LL.3() ) #>   ID   field   fungicida    Estimate   Std..Error #> 1  1 Organic Fungicide A 0.006072082 0.0005740341  ec50_multimodel(   growth ~ dose,   data = sample_data,   isolate_col = "isolate",   strata_col = c("field", "fungicida"),   fct = list(drc::LL.3(), drc::LL.4()) ) #>    ID   field   fungicida    Estimate   Std..Error    logLik       IC #> 1   1 Organic Fungicide A 0.006072082 0.0005740341 -45.15079 98.30158 #> 11  1 Organic Fungicide A 0.006364103 0.0007031475 -44.69257 99.38515 #>    Lack.of.fit   Res.var model #> 1    0.7271292 0.8451681  LL.3 #> 11   0.7370811 0.8498845  LL.4

title: Plot fitted dose-response curves for multiple isolates — plot_EC50_curves
text: x object returned [estimate_EC50()] [ec50_multimodel()]. two-sided formula `growth ~ dose` also accepted compatibility. data data frame containing response, dose, isolate, optional stratification columns. Required `x` formula. isolate_col Character scalar naming column identifies isolate. Required `x` formula. strata_col Optional character vector naming columns used split data fitting models. Used `x` formula. fct `drc` model function object `drc::LL.3()`, list model function objects `list(drc::LL.3(), drc::LL.4())`. Required `x` formula. color_col Character scalar naming column mapped curve point color. Defaults isolate column always converted factor plotting. facet_col, facet_row Optional character scalars naming columns used faceting. omitted, first two `strata_col` values used. models One `""`, `"best"`, character vector model names draw. `"best"` uses [best_model()] multimodel fits. n_points Number dose values used draw fitted curve. log_x Logical. `TRUE`, use log10 x-axis omit non-positive dose values plotted data prediction grid. point_size, point_alpha Size alpha raw observation points. line_width Width fitted curves. quiet Logical. `FALSE`, failed group/model fits reported warning.

title: Plot fitted dose-response curves for multiple isolates — plot_EC50_curves
text: `ggplot2` object. plotted curve data, observed data, fitted   models attached returned object `curve_data`,   `observed_data`, `fitted_models` attributes list elements.

title: Plot fitted dose-response curves for multiple isolates — plot_EC50_curves
code: data(multi_isolate) sample_data <- subset(   multi_isolate,   isolate %in% 1:4 & fungicida == "Fungicide A" )  fit <- estimate_EC50(   growth ~ dose,   data = sample_data,   isolate_col = "isolate",   strata_col = "field",   fct = drc::LL.3() ) plot_EC50_curves(fit)   multi_fit <- ec50_multimodel(   growth ~ dose,   data = sample_data,   isolate_col = "isolate",   strata_col = "field",   fct = list(drc::LL.3(), drc::LL.4()) ) plot_EC50_curves(multi_fit)

ec50estimator 1.0.0
text: Added plot_EC50_curves() plotting raw dose-response observations fitted drc curves across isolates, strata, one candidate models. estimate_EC50() ec50_multimodel() now store plotting metadata fitted models, allowing plot_EC50_curves(fit) without repeating formula, data, grouping columns, model functions. Added ec50_estimates(), ec50_metadata(), fitted_models(), curve_data() helpers working directly fitted EC50 objects. Added workflow helpers model selection, fit quality, failed fits, prediction, reporting, data checks, residual diagnostics. Reorganized pkgdown vignettes around user workflow: check data, fit models, diagnose fits, select models, plot curves, predict, report. Added new getting-started vignette rewrote single-model multimodel vignettes emphasize fit objects main interface. Removed row-name warnings predict_ec50() residual_data(). Added clearer validation formula, response, dose inputs, including stable empty outputs groups can fitted. Reset row names extractor outputs preserved model-selection columns -failed multimodel fits. Made quiet = TRUE suppress informational messages internal drc fitting calls. Added clear error plot_EC50_curves() asked models = "best" without fitted ec50_multimodel object. Modernized EC50 estimation internals shared validation, clearer errors, warnings failed isolate-level fits. Kept runtime dependencies focused drc ggplot2. Removed vignette-dependencies cowplot ggridges. Added support type = "relative" type = "absolute" estimate_EC50(). Added automated tests grouped estimates, argument validation, absolute effective-dose levels, multimodel output. Converted example dataset standard package data format. Refreshed vignette, README, pkgdown configuration.
